mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MATCHING_TBL VALUES (SEQ_MATCH_NO.NEXTVAL, #{userNo}, #{matchingTitle}, #{matchingContent}, DEFAULT, NULL, DEFAULT, #{matchingLocation}, NULL, NULL, #{matchingTime}, #{partnerType}, #{matchingType}, #{matchingUserCount}, NULL, #{matchingPrice}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{locationUrl}, #{addrName})
mapper.select:
SELECT M.MATCHING_NO, M.MATCHING_TITLE, M.MATCHING_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(M.MATCHING_PRICE, '999,999,999') AS MATCHINGPRICE, M.MATCHING_LOCATION, M.MATCHING_TIME, M.PARTNER_TYPE, M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT, M.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NAME, U.USER_PHONE, PER.CAREER, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL AT WHERE AT.MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO AND AT.DELETE_YN = 'N') AS APPLYCOUNT,
(SELECT IMG_PATH || '/' || IMG_RENAME FROM USER_PROFILE_IMG_TBL WHERE USER_NO = M.USER_NO AND IMG_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS USER_PROFILE_IMG,
CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO AND DELETE_YN = 'N') >= M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT THEN '마감'
WHEN (M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO AND DELETE_YN = 'N')) <= 2 THEN '마감임박' ELSE '모집중' END AS MATCHING_STATUS FROM MATCHING_TBL M JOIN USER_TBL U ON M.USER_NO = U.USER_NO JOIN REQUEST_PERMISSION PER ON M.USER_NO = PER.USER_NO
M.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND M.MATCHING_TYPE = 'TRAINER'
AND M.ADDR_NAME LIKE '%'||#{category}||'%'
AND (M.MATCHING_TITLE LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR M.PARTNER_TYPE LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%')
ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_TBL
MATCHING_TYPE = 'TRAINER' AND DELETE_YN = 'N'
AND ADDR_NAME ='%'||#{category}||'%'
AND (MATCHING_TITLE LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR PARTNER_TYPE LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%')
SELECT USER_NO FROM MATCHING_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = #{matchingNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_APPLI_NO = #{loginUserNo} AND MATCHING_NO = #{matchingNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE MATCHING_TBL SET DELETE_YN = 'Y' WHERE MATCHING_NO = #{matchingNo}
